comment: Castle rooftops (docs/regioes/topo-do-castelo.md): rooms painted tile by tile with ts_CastleTop, written by tools/templates/make_rooms.py (roadmap F12b-1 and the rest of the pilot). The kit's pieces are cells of ALttP area 0x1B (the top of Hyrule Castle; col, row of 16x16 blocks, incoming/topo-do-castelo/tiles/areas.json): the teal roof terrace is the floor, the cream wall tops and the riveted beige faces are walls, as on the original. A passage is a straight cut through the wall, as in the approved preview. The door sets are the fewest that cover every 1x1 and 1x2 room the Castle layouts gave in 12 seeds (scenario castle_top_layouts): passages of neighbouring positions touch, so a 1x1 room takes no two neighbours on the ring 1..12.

painted.name: Terrace
painted.comment: Roof terrace between the castle walls, as in the preview approved by Guilherme (oct/2026): towers with green lamps either side of the top passage, the Hylian crest in the middle.

painted.name: Crossroads
painted.comment: Where the walkways of the four sides meet: the crest in the middle, towers either side of the top passage.

painted.name: TwinGates
painted.comment: Two passages through the top wall with a lamp tower between them.

painted.name: Rampart
painted.comment: A long stretch of parapet: passages near the corners, a tower in the middle of the top wall, a bare terrace.

painted.name: TowerGate
painted.comment: The gate of Agahnim's tower set in the top wall, the passage to the right of it.

painted.name: LampCourt
painted.comment: Lamp towers either side of the top passage over a bare terrace; side passages near the corners.

painted.name: LowGates
painted.comment: Two passages through the bottom wall, towers either side of the top one.

painted.name: LongTerrace
painted.comment: A terrace two rooms long with passages all along the sides; towers by the top passage, the crest in the middle.

painted.name: LongRampart
painted.comment: A long terrace with passages near the corners and along the sides; a tower in the middle of the top wall.

painted.name: WideTerrace
painted.comment: A terrace two rooms wide: three passages in the top and bottom walls, side passages in the middle; lamp towers between the top passages, the crest in the middle.

painted.name: WideRampart
painted.comment: A wide stretch of parapet with passages near the corners of the sides; the gate of Agahnim's tower between the top passages.

painted.name: WideCourt
painted.comment: A wide court open to one side near the top and to the other in the middle; towers between the top passages over a bare terrace.
